name: Dockett Product Reviews for WooCommerce
author: dockett

sections.description:
Dockett Product Reviews for WooCommerce brings product reviews to WooCommerce: unlimited product and store reviews, automated post-purchase review-request emails, photo and video reviews, SEO rich snippets, and a full widget family (star badges, review widget, carousels, floating sidebar).

Highlights
* Unlimited product & store reviews
* Unlimited review request emails
* Unlimited photo & video reviews
* Google rich snippets (JSON-LD)
* Core widgets: review widget, star badge, carousel, floating tab, trust badge
* CSV import & export

Premium Features

The free version above is fully functional with no limits on reviews. Paid plans add more automation, AI, and integrations. Prices are per month.

Free — $0

Everything in the free version: unlimited product and store reviews, unlimited review-request emails, photo and video reviews, Google rich snippets, core widgets (review widget, star badge, basic carousel, floating tab, trust badge, snippets), CSV import and export, import from Loox, Yotpo, Stamped, AliExpress, Amazon, Etsy, Google, and Shop, basic email templates, 38+ languages, AI sentiment and topic labels, QR collection, past-order requests, in-email rating, reviewer name formats, spam and profanity filter.

Starter — $5 per month

Up to 3 automatic reminders, media reminder (follow-up asking text reviewers for a photo or video), Q&A section, custom questions and custom review forms, all-reviews page, coupons for reviews, referrals, basic webhooks.

Pro — $19 per month

AI summaries, AI replies, AI translation, AI FAQs, brand voice, AI auto-publish, SMS requests, delivery-based scheduling, customer segments, per-product schedules, advanced widgets (CSS, custom star icons, themes, expanded gallery), drag-and-drop email editor, custom sender domain, Google Shopping feed, social push (Facebook, Instagram, X), email integrations (Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Omnisend), loyalty integrations (Smile, LoyaltyLion), support integrations (Gorgias, Tidio), page-builder widgets, UGC Instagram, social-proof banners, widget grid, video carousel.

Accelerator — $134 per month

Analytics with benchmarks, social post scheduler, push and WhatsApp channels, multisite, full REST API and webhooks, TikTok Shop, priority support.

Studio — $200 per month

White-label widgets and emails, concierge migration (from Judge.me, Loox, and Yotpo), SLA support, agency toolkit.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate “Dockett Product Reviews for WooCommerce” through the Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Dockett Product Reviews for WooCommerce to configure.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Dockett Product Reviews for WooCommerce is built for WooCommerce product reviews.

How are review requests sent?

When an order is marked completed, a review request is queued and sent after a configurable delay (default 7 days), with an optional single reminder.

Is there a limit on reviews?

No. There is no limit on reviews.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Spam & profanity filter is now free and fully functional in every build, with its setting exposed in the admin screen; AI auto-publish code is not included in the WordPress.org lite version.
  • All widget and form output is now escaped late with wp_kses/wp_kses_post through a tight allowlist (SVG stars, data attributes and style kept); widget colors use sanitize_hex_color() for the CSS context and the lite version ships no custom-CSS field.
  • Text domain matches the plugin slug (dockett-product-reviews).

1.0.2

  • Plugin now has its own top-level admin menu (star icon) with 7 pages: Dashboard, Reviews, Requests, Widgets, Import & Export, Settings, Guide.

1.0.1

  • Fix: register rewrite rules on the init hook instead of plugins_loaded (prevents fatal on activation).

1.0.0

  • Initial skeleton release: tables, settings, widgets, REST API, request queue, licensing, database stub.
